coverage_note: PM7. Romania is the home market and is served end to end by the existing public_ro storefront (public_summary document class, data.gov.ro filings). This package must never hold a Romanian entity: one company answered by two document classes is two sources of truth and, eventually, two different numbers. The file is deliberately empty and universe.load_into_store() REFUSES a home-market seed that carries members, so this invariant is enforced by code and not only by convention.
